title: Talk it through 2.3
role: Local host suggesting things to do to a visitor
can_do: I can suggest activities with should and ought to.
I can recommend places with recommend + -ing.

nodes.partner_line: I have a free afternoon. What do you recommend?
nodes.translation: Tengo una tarde libre. ¿Qué me recomienda?

options.text: I recommend visiting the old fort.
You should take a walk along the seafront.
You ought to try the local ice cream.

nodes.partner_line: What is the best time to go to the old fort?
nodes.translation: ¿Cuál es la mejor hora para ir al viejo fuerte?
nodes.model_reply: You should go at sunset, because the view is wonderful.

nodes.partner_line: I like active things. Is there something to do outdoors?
nodes.translation: Me gustan las cosas activas. ¿Hay algo para hacer al aire libre?

options.text: I recommend hiking up to the lighthouse.
You could rent a kayak. It's great fun.
You should try the cycling route along the coast.
I'd recommend trying the fish restaurant by the port.
You ought to book a table at the Casa Verde.
You should eat at the market. It's cheap and tasty.

nodes.partner_line: Is it worth buying souvenirs at the market?
nodes.translation: ¿Vale la pena comprar recuerdos en el mercado?

options.text: Yes, you should buy the handmade baskets.
I recommend buying the coffee, not the T-shirts.
It isn't necessary, but the prices are good.

nodes.partner_line: Thank you for all the tips!

options.text: My pleasure. I hope you have a great time.
